details.flavorMarkdown: *A squat elemental assembled from pebbles and rough stones around a dense central core. Its blunt hands and planted feet suit it to guarding a small patch of ground.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Pebble fist

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

**Healing:** Elemental: magical HP healing applies; cannot swallow potions. Printed immunities only.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Fresh pebbles pile around an undisturbed buried marker.

**Purpose:** Keep the ground around its resting place unbroken.

**Tactics and retreat:** Defend a narrow route and jab whoever tries to move it.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Restore the marker or agree to dig elsewhere.

**Habitat:** Quarry; cave · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** No gemstones are guaranteed inside it.

**Summoning:** Elemental 1 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/64089a1c8961d7faff172f179448a8b6e57827ef/design/bestiary/summons/stone-knuckle.md).

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-stone-knuckle


**Category:** Elemental · **Role:** Small blocker · **CV:** 9

**Difficulty rationale:** No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Reference damage:** 2/3/4

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.1

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.000, O=2.000. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/64089a1c8961d7faff172f179448a8b6e57827ef/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
